3b67.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds accumulator A to $F0/$F1 with carry, then RTS. Native-only helper.
3b67.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3b7a.name: RLE-EXPAND-RUN
3b7a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Decodes escape $8D: control top two bits plus one give group size, low six bits initialize the repeat countdown; reads the group and writes strided bytes. A zero countdown wraps to256 repetitions in this native loop. Returns RTS.
3b7a.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3bc1.name: RLE-EXPAND-COLUMNS
3bc1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native decoder consumes literals or $8D runs column by column, using $F7 columns, $F8 rows and $F6 destination stride. Returns with RTS.
3bc1.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3c04.name: RLE-EXPAND
3c04.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves the Forth X stack pointer, calls native column decoder $3BC3, restores X and jumps to NEXT.

3c17.name: RLE-SIZE!
3c17.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores rows in $F8 and columns in $F7 for the column decoder.

3c2a.name: RLE-POINTERS!
3c2a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores destination in $F2/$F3 and source in $F0/$F1.

3c3d.name: RLE-STRIDE!
3c3d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the low byte of its argument in $F6.

3c4b.name: BANK-COPY-LENGTH
3c4b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: 16-bit count read by $3CB1: high byte supplies full 256-byte pages and low byte a final partial page.

3c54.name: BANK-COPY-SOURCE
3c54.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $DD, the source pointer used by native $3C92.

3c5d.name: BANK-COPY-DEST
3c5d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $DF, the destination pointer used by native $3C92.

3c67.name: NMI-ENABLE-SHADOW
3c67.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Software shadow for NMIEN. Color DLI install selects $E0 bits; banked-copy routines set NMIEN=0 before hiding OS ROM and restore this byte afterward.

3c71.name: ENTER-RAM-UNDER-OS
3c71.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for the VCOUNT bit7 transition, synchronizes WSYNC, disables NMIEN and IRQs, then decrements PORTB to expose RAM beneath the OS ROM. Native RTS entry.
3c71.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3c92.name: COPY-BANK-PAGE
3c92.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: After exposing RAM under OS, copies Y bytes backward through $DD/$DF, restores PORTB and the saved NMIEN value, enables IRQs and RTS. Y=0 copies256 bytes.
3c92.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3cb1.name: COPY-BANK-BYTES
3cb1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the full pages and remainder specified by $3C4B through native $3C92, preserving the Forth parameter-stack X register.

3ce0.name: COPY-UNDER-OS
3ce0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores length and both bank-copy pointers, then executes $3CB1. Tutorial PMOVE has the same parameter roles, but this game uses its own raster-synchronized implementation.

3cf8.name: BANK-FIRST-SPAN
3cf8.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $2800 is the size of logical offsets mapped to physical $D800..$FFFF; later offsets map from $C000.

3d02.name: SPLIT-BANK-RANGE
3d02.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Splits a logical offset/count pair at $2800 into physical copy spans, mapping lower offsets from $D800 and higher offsets from $C000. Called by both directions of bank transfer.
3d02.stack_effect: offset count -- address1 count1 address2 count2 count1

3d89.name: STORE-BANK-RANGE
3d89.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses $3D02 to split the logical range, then copies from normal RAM into one or two physical RAM-under-OS spans with $3CE0.

3dac.name: FETCH-BANK-RANGE
3dac.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses $3D02 to split the logical range, then copies one or two RAM-under-OS spans into contiguous normal RAM with $3CE0.

3dce.name: SPLIT-UNSIGNED-BYTES
3dce.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native code moves the original high byte to a new zero-extended stack cell and clears both high halves.

3de7.name: PATCH-VBI-SLOT
3de7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Parses a Forth name with -FIND, writes JSR opcode $20 at table+1+3*slot and stores the target native entry after it; otherwise prints ERROR VBI.

3e2a.name: VBI-CALL-TABLE
3e2a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Mutable native JSR/NOP slots ending in a jump to $3E59. INSTALL-GAME-VBI installs table+1 as the immediate VBI via SETVBV A=6.

3e47.name: VBI-SLOT!
3e47.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Supplies the VBI call table to $3DE7; the parsed name determines the installed JSR target.

3e57.name: CONTINUE-OS-VBI
3e57.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native JMP $E45F continues the OS SYSVBV handler after this game's immediate VBI; it is not a Forth NEXT return or XITVBV.
3e57.calling_convention: Assembly VBI continuation; jumps to OS SYSVBV.

3e66.name: INSTALL-GAME-VBI
3e66.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native SETVBV call at $E45C installs the game interrupt entry $3E2D with selector six.

3e83.name: RESTORE-OS-VBI
3e83.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native SETVBV call restores the operating system VBI entry $E45F with selector six.

3e9c.name: RECORD-SPAN
3e9c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Shared scratch cell. PM-plane copying uses it as per-plane byte length; bank resource lookup stores the record payload length here, while the optimized scanner temporarily reuses its low byte for pointer addition.

3ea6.name: RECORD-WRAP-HIGH
3ea6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native scan $3ED1 compares pointer high byte against this threshold, initially $A7, then sets it to $D8 after wrapping the resource window.

3eaf.name: RECORD-POINTER
3eaf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $D2, the current pointer used by resource scanning and PM-plane copies.

3eb9.name: ADVANCE-RECORD-POINTER
3eb9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds the 16-bit RECORD-SPAN cell to $D2/$D3 and returns with RTS.
3eb9.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3ed1.name: SCAN-LENGTH-RECORDS
3ed1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks u16-length records and advances $D2/$D3 by length+2 with direct pointer arithmetic, wrapping the banked resource window at its threshold. Unlike Klatwa, it does not retain each span length in $3E9C. Native RTS.

3f15.name: SET-RECORD-SCAN-POINTER
3f15.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the top Forth cell into $D2/$D3 and saves X in XSAVE; native helper returns RTS without dropping parameters.
3f15.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3f28.name: SCAN-RAM-RECORD
3f28.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets the wrap threshold to $A7, initializes $D2/$D3, scans records, and drops both arguments; resulting address remains in RECORD-POINTER.

3f42.name: LENGTH-RECORD-TABLE:
3f42.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Defining word stores a u16 total length and allocates bytes. Its DOES> tail skips that length and indexes variable-length records through $3F28, returning the record header address.

3f5f.name: WORD-COUNT
3f5f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves the length-header address on the return stack, returns address+2 and its u16 length. Equivalent interface to COUNT for 16-bit lengths.

3f74.name: LENGTH-RECORD-ADDR
3f74.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Runs $3F28 and fetches its resulting $D2/$D3 pointer. The result points at the u16 length field.

3f86.name: STORE-QUOTED-RECORD
3f86.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Parses text delimited by a double quote, copies the characters after the record's u16 header, then stores the text length in that header.

3fad.name: RECORD-OFFSET
3fad.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves base, scans indexed record, and subtracts base from the resulting pointer.

3fc5.name: BANKED-TRANSFER
3fc5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Nonzero selects sector transfer through PAD and the logical bank-copy helpers; zero transfers directly through normal RAM. Set by $5C88 when loading banked scene assets.

3fdc.name: TRANSFER-BANK-OFFSET
3fdc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Logical bank offset advanced by B/BUF during the PAD-staged disk transfer.

3fe6.name: PREPARE-SECTOR-BUFFER
3fe6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: In normal mode leaves all three transfer arguments unchanged. In banked mode replaces the address with PAD after fetching a sector from the supplied logical bank offset; retains first/count.
3fe6.stack_effect: address first count -- buffer first count

400d.name: ADVANCE-SECTOR-BUFFER
400d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For normal RAM adds B/BUF; in banked mode keeps PAD, updates the logical offset and copies a sector between PAD and banked RAM according to S-L.

4054.name: DIRECTORY-BUFFER
4054.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Points at the PAD+B/BUF sector buffer loaded from DIRB by $4069.

405e.name: GROUP-END-SECTOR
405e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Set to start sector plus sector count while $4069 resolves a directory entry.

4069.name: FIND-GAM-GROUP
4069.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads directory sector DIRB, sums preceding one-byte group lengths, compensates for the directory-sector hole and returns start/count with zero error, or an error result.

40e5.name: TRANSFER-GROUP-SECTORS
40e5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Transfers consecutive sectors through -DISK using S-L; skips the directory sector when encountered, advances/stages the buffer and returns a zero/nonzero error status.

421c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the result of the DIRL/DSL disk operation and is checked by title and game loading paths.

4242.name: SAVE-GAM-GROUP
4242.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Checks disk ID, invokes DIRS/DSL, updates the cached group length, and writes the directory when a formerly empty group was successfully allocated; stores the result at $421C.

42a2.name: WAIT-FRAMES
42a2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loops until Atari RTCLOK low byte $14 changes, once per requested frame.

42ca.name: ENABLE-DLI-AT
42ca.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets bit $80 in a display-list instruction byte to request a DLI.

42e2.name: GAME-COLOR-TABLE
42e2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Triplets read by COLOR-TABLE-DLI into COLPF0..2; $5E1A installs the gameplay colors here.

42fc.name: DLI-COLOR-OFFSET
42fc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Byte index into the color table; native DLI advances by three and resets after VCOUNT reaches $40.

4307.name: DLI-COLOR-POINTER
4307.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $DB, zero-page pointer dereferenced by the color-table DLI.

4312.name: COLOR-TABLE-DLI
4312.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native interrupt handler preserves A/Y, sends successive table triplets to GTIA $D016..$D018 and returns RTI.

4346.name: INSTALL-COLOR-DLI
4346.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores native $4314 in VDSLST ($0200), clears its table index and enables NMI bits in both the shadow and $D40E.

4377.name: PAUSE-COLOR-DLI
4377.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects NMI mask $60, waits a frame, and copies the first color triplet to OS shadows $02C4 and live GTIA $D016 before disabling DLI.

4499.name: DRAW-TEXT-FRAME
4499.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Computes screen address from SAVMSC, column and row; invokes (RAM), then advances text coordinates into the frame interior.

44ca.name: DRAW-CENTERED-TEXT-FRAME
44ca.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets column to 20-width/2 and draws the frame at the current row.

44e5.name: MESSAGE-FIRST-LINE-WIDTH
44e5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: $44F8 stores the first or second line width plus four here; later UI code can size message choices from this value.

44ee.name: MESSAGE-FRAME-WIDTH
44ee.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores maximum counted-line length plus four, with a seven-column special case for a single-line message.

44f8.name: MEASURE-MESSAGE
44f8.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks a line-count byte followed by counted strings, computes maximum width+4, stores width fields and uses width seven when there is only one line.

4561.name: NEXT-TEXT-ROW
4561.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Increments the OS text row through Y@ and Y!.

4571.name: PRINT-CENTERED-LINES
4571.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks the counted-line message, sets each starting column to 20-length/2, prints via STYPE, and advances the row.

45a1.name: SHOW-MESSAGE
45a1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For a nonempty counted-line group, measures and draws its frame, prints centered lines, then restores the original row and sets column zero. Unlike Klatwa this word does not first erase the following text rows.

45d2.name: DISK-ERROR-MESSAGES
45d2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: u16-length vector contains disk-error and wrong-disk Polish prompts, including BLAD DYSKOWY and NIE TEN DYSK; $462A displays the selected entry after a transfer error.

462a.name: SHOW-DISK-ERROR
462a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes the disk-error vector, skips its u16 header and displays the multiline message.

463a.name: TRANSFER-IS-LOAD
463a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects $4228 load when nonzero or $4242 save when zero in $46BE.

4644.name: TEXT-PANEL-PATTERN
4644.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: u16 length plus alternating custom-font bytes $3B/$3D; $466E tiles this pattern across the panel and $4B45 copies part into its border.

466e.name: CLEAR-TEXT-AREA
466e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resets text position, then fills nine32-byte panel rows from alternating offsets in TEXT-PANEL-PATTERN using40-byte screen stride; finishes the lower border with byte$0F. This is a patterned clear rather than an ERASE.

46be.name: TRY-GROUP-TRANSFER
46be.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Keeps transfer arguments, clears text, pauses the DLI, tries load/save, resumes DLI, and displays/acknowledges an error if needed.
46be.stack_effect: address count group -- address count group

46fc.name: RETRY-GROUP-TRANSFER
46fc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeats $46BE until the stored transfer error is zero, then drops the retained transfer arguments.

4716.name: READ-RESOURCE-GROUP
4716.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets transfer mode to read and invokes the retrying transfer.

4728.name: WRITE-RESOURCE-GROUP
4728.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets transfer mode to write and invokes the retrying transfer.

473a.name: READ-BANK-RECORD-LENGTH
473a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper reads the u16 at ($D2),Y into RECORD-SPAN; returns RTS. Used while OS ROM is switched out.
473a.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

474f.name: SCAN-BANK-RECORD
474f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a banked u16-length record. For indices at least32, scans the excess first, restores interrupts, then re-enters the bank and scans32 more; reads the resulting length, restores PORTB/NMIEN/IRQs and drops both arguments.

479d.name: BANK-RECORD-RANGE
479d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Scans a banked record, skips its u16 header, converts the physical address to a logical offset (subtracting $D800 or $9800), and returns its payload length.

47d0.name: NESTED-BANK-RECORD
47d0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: First indexes a collection at banked base $D800, then indexes its nested record and returns the logical payload range.

47e9.name: BANK-RESOURCE-RANGE
47e9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses banked base $D800 and returns the indexed resource's payload offset and length.

47f9.name: RESOURCE-BASE
47f9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pointer to the visible RAM resource collection, initially $A460; $4803 fetches it and $482A indexes its u16-length records.

4803.name: RESOURCE-BASE@
4803.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches the visible resource collection base from $47F9, initially $A460.

4811.name: PICTURE-STAGING-BASE
4811.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pointer cell initially $A412; its fetched address receives decoded item pictures before scene composition.

481b.name: PICTURE-STAGING@
481b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches PICTURE-STAGING-BASE; $5898 decodes item art here and $545D composites it into the scene picture.

482a.name: RESOURCE-ADDR
482a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes a u16-length record at RESOURCE-BASE through $3F74; returns its length header.

4838.name: FETCH-RESOURCE-TO
4838.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a banked resource payload and copies it to the supplied normal-RAM destination.

4849.name: FETCH-NESTED-RESOURCE
4849.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a nested banked resource and copies its payload to the supplied destination.

485c.name: FETCH-RESOURCE
485c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the chosen banked resource into the visible RESOURCE-BASE buffer.

4869.name: WAIT-RASTER-HALF
4869.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native loop waits for VCOUNT bit7 to clear and then set; returns RTS. Used to synchronize player positions and graphics work.
4869.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

487b.name: WAIT-RASTER
487b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls the native raster wait at $486B and returns to Forth NEXT.

488a.name: GRAPHICS-BASE
488a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the graphics address from INSTALL-DISPLAY and is used by graphics memory operations.

4896.name: EXPAND-SCREEN-DESCRIPTOR
4896.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads the destination cell, then expands width/row-count/pattern records sequentially into destination RAM until a zero pattern terminator. Consumes the descriptor address; runtime test expands width2, rows3, pattern11/22 into six bytes.

48f0.name: INSTALL-DISPLAY
48f0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Installs text screen address at SAVMSC $0058, stores the graphics base, and writes SDLSTL $0230.

491b.name: FRAME-PATTERN-DATA
491b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two frame-row patterns filled with $55 bytes and containing display-line pointers. $4B09 uses them as left/right borders; transition routines also point display lines into this pattern block.

4977.name: GAME-SCREEN-DESCRIPTOR
4977.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Despite its saved DOCOL code field, the body is screen-description data beginning at $4979. $4C38/$4C4D pass that literal address to $48F0; it is not executed as Forth.
4977.calling_convention: Data body referenced by literal address; do not execute its saved DOCOL entry.

49a7.name: ROOM-BITMAP-ADDRESS
49a7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $A830 is the room bitmap address used when opening the display-line transition.

49b1.name: TRANSITION-ROW-PAIRS
49b1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant 56 is the transition loop bound; a displayed 112-row room uses paired rows.

49c5.name: FRAME-ROW-POINTER
49c5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pointer cell set to one of the two frame-row patterns by $4B09; $4AD3 copies the left/right borders through its value. The following cell is unused padding in this entry.

49d0.name: TRANSITION-IS-CLOSING
49d0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero chooses sequential room bitmap rows; nonzero chooses the fixed frame-pattern address for closing the scene.

49da.name: TRANSITION-LINE-ADDRESS
49da.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: 16-bit display-memory address written into successive display-list address fields by $49EE.

49e4.name: TRANSITION-LINE-COUNT
49e4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Byte count decremented by native $49EE while patching display-line pointers.

49ee.name: PATCH-TRANSITION-LINES
49ee.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for the raster, stores the current display-memory pointer through $D2, advances the display-list pointer by RECORD-SPAN and, when opening, advances image memory by$190 per write. Repeats TRANSITION-LINE-COUNT times.

4a28.name: SET-TRANSITION-COLUMN
4a28.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets display-list address pointer to $A706+4*index; when closing uses FRAME-PATTERN-DATA, otherwise sets image pointer to $A830+80*index.

4a5f.name: ANIMATE-SCENE-TRANSITION
4a5f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets display-list step20 bytes; patches12 lines in the first interleaved pass, then four passes of11 lines, selecting successive start offsets through $4A28.

4a95.name: OPEN-SCENE-TRANSITION
4a95.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears TRANSITION-IS-CLOSING and performs the five interleaved display-line pointer passes, revealing the room bitmap.

4aa7.name: CLOSE-SCENE-TRANSITION
4aa7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets TRANSITION-IS-CLOSING and performs the interleaved display-line pointer passes using the frame-pattern address.

4ab9.name: FILL-AND-ADVANCE
4ab9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves count, fills the requested bytes with the supplied value, then returns address+count.

4ad3.name: DRAW-FRAME-ROW
4ad3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies four left border bytes, clears the next 32 bytes, and copies four right border bytes from the current frame pattern.

4b09.name: DRAW-SCENE-FRAME
4b09.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Iterates the 112-row bitmap in 80-byte row pairs, drawing the alternating frame-row patterns around a 32-byte interior.

4b45.name: DRAW-TEXT-PANEL-BORDERS
4b45.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears400 bytes of the text screen, draws custom-font top/bottom and side borders at temporary SAVMSC positions, restores SAVMSC and copies the patterned top row.

4c38.name: OPEN-GAME-SCREEN
4c38.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Installs the screen descriptor, performs the opening transition, and clears the text area.

4c4d.name: INIT-GAME-SCREEN
4c4d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Installs the screen descriptor, draws text-panel borders and the alternating scene frame, then clears the text area.

4c63.name: BYTE-PAIR@
4c63.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads adjacent bytes at address and address+1 as zero-extended values.

4c79.name: BYTE+!
4c79.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds delta to the byte at address, storing only the low eight bits.

4c90.name: SCENE-PICTURE-BUFFER
4c90.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $0600 is the decompressed scene/zoom picture buffer, with x,y,width,height followed by pixels.

4c99.name: PICTURE-X-OFFSET
4c99.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stored by $4CE1 as picture x minus the supplied destination origin; used by $4CC8 for composition placement.

4ca2.name: PICTURE-Y-OFFSET
4ca2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stored by $4CE1 as picture y minus the supplied destination origin; used by $4CC8 and hit-map placement.

4cab.name: EXPAND-PICTURE-DATA
4cab.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads width/height from the source, advances past its two-byte dimensions, sets RLE parameters and expands into destination with the requested stride.

4cc8.name: PICTURE-OFFSET
4cc8.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds PICTURE-X-OFFSET and stride*PICTURE-Y-OFFSET to the supplied base.

4ce1.name: SET-PICTURE-OFFSETS
4ce1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads picture x/y and subtracts supplied origin coordinates, storing relative x/y offsets.

4d05.name: OVERLAY-PACKED-PICTURE
4d05.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses both four-byte picture headers to compute relative placement, then expands source RLE bytes into destination at its own row stride.

4d31.name: DRAW-RESOURCE-PICTURE
4d31.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves the picture record, sets origin-relative offsets using x=4/y=0, then decodes the image into BITMAP-BASE at its stored x/y with stride40.

4d62.name: DECODE-PICTURE
4d62.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the source's x/y/width/height header to destination, then expands its packed payload there.

4d7c.name: DECODE-SCENE-RESOURCE
4d7c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a picture resource and decodes it into the $0600 scene picture buffer.

4d8e.name: OVERLAY-SCENE-RESOURCE
4d8e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a packed picture and overlays it into the existing $0600 scene picture buffer.

4d9f.name: HIT-MAP-SELECTOR
4d9f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero chooses the base hit map; nonzero selects the zoom hit map at +$284. Scene/zoom drawing routines set it explicitly.

4da8.name: HIT-MAP-BASE
4da8.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $A0D5 addresses the base room hit map; its first two bytes contain width and height.

4db2.name: HIT-MAP@
4db2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns hit-map base $A0D5, adding $284 when HIT-MAP-SELECTOR is nonzero.

4dcc.name: PLAYER-COLORS
4dcc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Bytes copied to OS PCOLR0..3 at $02C0 by $4DDB to color the player/missile cursor.

4ddb.name: SET-PLAYER-COLORS
4ddb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies four bytes from PLAYER-COLORS to OS color shadows $02C0..$02C3.

4df1.name: PM-BASE
4df1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell stores the player/missile memory base in bytes; set while writing PMBASE hardware $D407.

4dfc.name: PLAYER-DATA-BASE
4dfc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns PM-BASE+$400, the first player area for the configured single-line PM graphics.

4e11.name: PM-BASE!
4e11.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes the page number to ANTIC PMBASE $D407 and stores page*256 in PM-BASE.

4e2e.name: CLEAR-PLAYERS
4e2e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Erases $2FF bytes from PM-BASE+$400, covering the cursor's three player planes.

4e42.name: ENABLE-PLAYERS
4e42.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes three to GTIA GRACTL $D01D, enabling missile and player DMA display.

4e57.name: DISABLE-PLAYERS
4e57.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears eight horizontal position registers at $D000 and writes zero to GRACTL.

4e81.name: SET-CURSOR-PM-X
4e81.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for the raster point, then writes the supplied x to HPOSP0, HPOSP1 and HPOSP2 and drops it.

4e9a.name: CURSOR-PLAYER-BITMAP
4e9a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Body at $4E9C contains three 13-byte cursor planes. $4F1E refers to that literal body address; its saved DOCOL field is not evidence this data is executable Forth.
4e9a.calling_convention: Data body referenced by literal address; do not execute its saved DOCOL entry.

4eca.name: PM-COPY-DEST
4eca.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $D4, the destination pointer used by the native player-plane copy.

4ed5.name: PM-COPY-PLANES
4ed5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native $4EF4 uses its low byte as plane count and advances destination by256 for each plane.

4ee2.name: PM-COPY-PARAMETERS!
4ee2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores plane count and the per-plane byte count (the shared RECORD-SPAN cell).

4ef4.name: COPY-PM-PLANES
4ef4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for raster, copies each plane from $D2 to $D4, advances source by plane length and destination by256, preserving Forth X.

4f1e.name: SET-CURSOR-PM-Y
4f1e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the fixed three-plane,13-row cursor bitmap to PM-BASE+$400+y using $4EF4.

4f4c.name: CONTEXT-BYTE-ARRAY:
4f4c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Defining word stores an index-cell address and allocates bytes; DOES> fetches that index and adds it to the payload address.

4f68.name: CURSOR-AXIS
4f68.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero selects horizontal cursor cells; one selects the adjacent vertical cells in the four context-indexed arrays.

4f73.name: CURSOR-ORIGIN
4f73.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed byte origins used with grid step and position to compute PM screen coordinates.

4f82.name: CURSOR-GRID-POS
4f82.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed cursor x/y grid positions; input wait returns both bytes and navigation saves/restores their pair.

4f91.name: CURSOR-GRID-STEP
4f91.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed pixel steps, normally x4 and y6; $4FB9 scales the selected grid position by this value.

4fa0.name: CURSOR-GRID-LIMIT
4fa0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed maximum grid coordinates; movement stops at zero or this limit.

4fae.name: CURSOR-MOVE-DELTA
4fae.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the signed one-step input delta during animated cursor movement.

4fb9.name: CURSOR-PIXEL
4fb9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Computes selected-axis origin + grid-position*grid-step.

4fd4.name: STEP-CURSOR
4fd4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For nonzero signed movement, checks the selected-axis limit, animates PM position across one grid step and adjusts its stored grid byte. Intended deltas are -1,0,+1.

504c.name: JOYSTICK-TRIGGER
504c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads Atari hardware trigger $D010 plus the joystick number and masks bit zero; zero means pressed.

5061.evidence: Candidate name; structural sequence match, not an independently verified semantic match. Corresponding AD2044 CFA $4F47 (-1) in contiguous 3-definition sequence matching header flags, name suffix, word kind and body size. GAM FORTH 11_A_Graf.ATR CFA $9612, identical body after known address relocation; surviving name length and suffix match

506b.name: STICK-X-DELTA-TABLE
506b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Threaded selector indexed by raw STICK nibble minus five; entries yield +1,-1 or0 for horizontal movement.

508d.name: STICK-Y-DELTA-TABLE
508d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Companion selector yields vertical -1/0/+1 after the raw joystick nibble is reduced by five.

50b2.name: JOYSTICK-DELTA
50b2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads STICK0 at $0278 plus joystick index, subtracts five, and maps through two direction tables.

50d2.name: INIT-CURSOR-PLAYERS
50d2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets SDMCTL=$3E and GPRIOR=1, selects PM base $A000, clears players, installs their colors and enables GRACTL.

50fc.name: CURSOR-ORIGIN!
50fc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets vertical origin y+$21 and horizontal origin 4*x+$32 in the axis-indexed cursor array.

512a.name: CURSOR-LIMITS!
512a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores rows-1 and columns-1 as vertical/horizontal maximum grid positions.

514d.name: CURSOR-STEPS!
514d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the horizontal and vertical byte steps used to animate cursor movement.

5166.name: VIEW-STACK
5166.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counted stack of 16-bit view IDs; the first byte counts stored bytes. $517D pushes and $51AA pops.

517d.name: PUSH-VIEW
517d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the cell at VIEW-STACK+count+2, then increments the byte count by two. This implementation has no capacity check.

5197.name: P
5197.evidence: Intact dictionary name in supplied Wladcy Ciemnosci v1 image.

51aa.name: POP-VIEW
51aa.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches the cell at VIEW-STACK+count, then decrements a nonzero byte count by two; zero count returns the initial cell.

51d0.name: CELL-ARRAY:
51d0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Defining word allocates twice the requested count; DOES> doubles the index and adds it to the payload.

51ec.name: VIEW-CURSOR-POSITIONS
51ec.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array stores one cursor x/y byte pair for each view-stack byte-count index, as used by $5204/$5220.

5204.name: RESTORE-VIEW-CURSOR
5204.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes saved cursor cells by current VIEW-STACK byte count, fetches the packed pair and writes it to the horizontal/vertical cursor bytes.

5220.name: SAVE-VIEW-CURSOR
5220.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the current packed cursor position at the cell-array index given by the current VIEW-STACK byte count.

523c.name: CENTER-VIEW-CURSOR
523c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses active hit-map dimensions: y becomes height/2 and x becomes width/2-1.

5266.name: CONFIGURE-VIEW-CURSOR
5266.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses picture origin for a zoom view or x4/y0 for the base view, applies active hit-map dimensions as limits and fixes cursor steps to4/6 pixels.

5298.name: HIT-MAP-CELL
5298.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns the hit-map byte at base+2+x+y*width for the currently selected map.

52b3.name: HIT-MAP-OFFSET
52b3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds horizontal picture offset and stride*(vertical offset/6), matching six bitmap rows per hit-map row.

52d1.name: EXPAND-HIT-MAP
52d1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Decodes a packed width/height hit-map record at its relative picture offset into the active hit-map buffer.

52ed.name: LOAD-BASE-HIT-MAP
52ed.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the base map, copies its dimensions (doubling width), configures/centers the cursor and expands the packed map.

5319.name: LOAD-ZOOM-HIT-MAP
5319.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the zoom map, copies its width/height header and expands its packed payload.

5337.name: OVERLAY-HIT-MAP
5337.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a mask resource and expands it into the current hit map using the current picture offsets.

5346.name: MASK-PICTURE-BYTE
5346.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper processes four two-bit pixels, combines a source-pixel mask with destination, and tracks runs through $FC. Returns masked byte in $FA with RTS.
5346.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5384.name: BLIT-MASKED
5384.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero makes $538D copy source directly; nonzero enables masked blending with the optional hit/depth comparison.

538d.name: BLEND-PICTURE-BYTE
538d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies a source pixel byte directly when BLIT-MASKED is zero; otherwise calls $5346, ORs source pixels with the masked background and stores them. This game has no Klatwa hit/depth threshold branch. Native RTS.
538d.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

53ae.name: BLEND-PICTURE-ROW
53ae.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls the byte blending helper for Y=0 through width-1, width held in $F7. Native RTS helper.
53ae.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

53c1.name: BLEND-PICTURE-ROWS
53c1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For each row, clears the pixel-run counter, blends width bytes, advances source and destination by their independent strides, then decrements height. No Klatwa row clipping or hit-map pointer progression remains. Native RTS.
53c1.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

53ed.name: BLIT-PICTURE
53ed.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves the Forth stack register while invoking the native rectangle compositor at $53C3.

53fe.name: PICTURE-SCREEN-ADDR
53fe.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads picture x/y and returns BITMAP-BASE+x+40*y.

541a.name: BLIT-PARAMETERS
541a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores destination stride, source pointer and width/height/source stride, then calls the native blitter. Header begins with width/height.

5441.name: DRAW-DECODED-PICTURE
5441.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Converts the picture's x/y header into its screen address, sets destination pointer and blits width/height pixels with40-byte screen stride.

545d.name: COMPOSE-STAGED-PICTURE
545d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses staged picture and $0600 scene headers to calculate relative offsets, then blits the staged image into the scene buffer using scene width as destination stride.

548f.name: SCENE-BACKUP-PICTURE
548f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $0A00 is a four-byte picture header followed by a saved screen rectangle used when entering/leaving zoom views.

54a3.name: SAVE-SCENE-BACKGROUND
54a3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the scene picture header to $0A00 and captures its screen rectangle using40-byte source stride and the blitter; unlike Klatwa, it performs no extra banked backup.

54e8.name: ITEM-RESOURCE-BASE
54e8.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $8D4D is the normal-RAM base of item-art u16-length resources, indexed by $54F2.

54f2.name: ITEM-RESOURCE-ADDR
54f2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes the item-art length-record collection at $9932.

5500.name: SAVED-STATE-BASE
5500.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Start of the contiguous saved state copied by game load/save; initial cells2 and10 precede CURRENT-ROOM and the power-slot records. No more specific direct reader is established.

550d.name: CURRENT-ROOM
550d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Room cell set by $59F0 and read by room/view list selection, achievements and high-level game actions.

5517.name: POWER-SLOT-RECORDS
5517.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Eight length-prefixed power records contain three metadata bytes plus13 display-name bytes. $603C renders SPIS MOCY; $61F2 checks the selected power and two inventory requirements; $6294 installs matching or empty slot metadata.

55b4.name: ITEM-POSITIONS
55b4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array of saved item x/y pairs. $5898 indexes it by objectID-$CA and installs these coordinates before drawing a dropped item.

55f8.name: PART2-ITEM-POSITIONS
55f8.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initial item x/y coordinate table copied into the live ITEM-POSITIONS table when beginning the second part.

5631.name: CURRENT-PART-GROUP
5631.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the game-part resource group. Start/load paths set2 or4; saved-game loading derives group4 or6 by adding two.

564e.name: ROOM-OBJECT-STATE
564e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Mutable nested u16-length room/view object records. $59DC takes room/view and returns the selected list; scene redraw and object-changing actions consume these records.

57e0.name: ROOM-ACHIEVEMENT-BITS
57e0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Room-indexed achievement bit bytes updated and counted by progress routines. The buffer contains25 active room bytes plus padding; game actions set particular event bits.

5802.name: PUZZLE-STATE-CELLS
5802.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexed puzzle-state cell array shared by power, object and ending actions. Consumers treat its entries as independent flags/counters; no single narrower meaning covers the whole array.

583d.name: PATH-X
583d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Movement handlers update this coordinate for the path puzzle; used with PATH-Y and directional move counters.

5846.name: PATH-Y
5846.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Movement handlers update this coordinate for the path puzzle; used with PATH-X and directional move counters.

584f.name: PATH-MOVES-LEFT
584f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell initially12, adjusted by the path-movement handlers as the puzzle move budget.

585a.name: PATH-LAST-DIRECTION
585a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell initially1; path handlers record previous direction here for their movement constraints.

5865.name: PATH-DIRECTION-COUNTS
5865.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Four16-bit direction counters, initially5,2,0,3, updated by the path-movement handlers $7E82..$7ECC.

5876.name: LAST-DIRECTION
5876.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Previous movement direction cell used by ordinary navigation and retained in the saved state; separate from the path puzzle's direction at $585A.

5880.name: ITEM-PICTURE-INDEX
5880.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Maps an inventory/drop object ID to its picture resource: 2*(object-$CA)+2, followed by its paired mask resource.

5898.name: COMPOSE-DROPPED-ITEM
5898.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Enables masked blending, decodes item art, applies the saved ITEM-POSITIONS coordinates, composes it into the scene and expands its paired hit map, then disables masked blending.

58de.name: DRAW-BASE-PICTURE
58de.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the selected picture directly to screen and loads the next resource as its base hit map.

58f0.name: DRAW-PICTURE-AND-MASK
58f0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the picture; only if the word after its length-bounded payload is nonzero does it expand the next resource as a hit-map overlay.

5916.name: DECODE-ZOOM-PICTURE
5916.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Decodes a picture into the scene buffer and loads the following resource as the zoom hit map.

5928.name: COMPOSE-PICTURE-AND-MASK
5928.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Overlays a picture in the scene buffer, then expands its following mask resource into the selected hit map.

593a.name: ROOM-RECORD-BUFFER
593a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $8CC1 is the normal-RAM room descriptor staging buffer. Background drawing loads a nested record here before choosing its graphics resources.

5943.name: SPLIT-OBJECT-ID
5943.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Divides by100, doubles the quotient for the resource collection number and retains the remainder as the local object index.

5958.name: CLASSIFY-OBJECT
5958.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: IDs0/1 produce only0; IDs above200 retain the original ID and return1 (item art); IDs2..200 load the collection selected by ID/100 and return local index followed by class2 (scene art). Stack arity therefore differs for ignored IDs.

598b.name: DRAW-OBJECT-LIST
598b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks object bytes in a u16-length record beginning at start; classifies each ID and draws its picture/mask when nonzero.

59b4.name: DRAW-ROOM-BACKGROUND
59b4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches room-1 from nested collection1 into ROOM-RECORD-BUFFER, loads its specified resource group, draws base picture0 and remaining static object entries.

59dc.name: ROOM-VIEW-OBJECTS
59dc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes outer ROOM-OBJECT-STATE by room, skips its u16 header, then indexes the selected view's u16-length object list.

59f0.name: DRAW-ROOM
59f0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores CURRENT-ROOM, draws its static background, then draws the mutable object list for base view0.

5a0c.name: EXPAND-THREE-BYTE-ROW
5a0c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper expands a three-byte template across a wider destination row: first and last bytes are borders, middle byte repeats. Returns RTS.
5a0c.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5a39.name: ADVANCE-EXPANDED-ROW
5a39.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds destination width $F7 to $F0/$F1 through the RLE source-pointer increment helper; native RTS.
5a39.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5a47.name: ADVANCE-ROW-TEMPLATE
5a47.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds three to template pointer $F2/$F3; native RTS.
5a47.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5a5b.name: EXPAND-SIX-ROWS
5a5b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeats the three-byte row expansion six times, decrementing remaining height and advancing both pointers; native RTS.
5a5b.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5a74.name: EXPAND-PICTURE-FRAME
5a74.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Expands the first six template rows, repeats the middle six-row strip, then adds a final strip; used to frame zoom pictures.

5a98.name: PREPARE-ZOOM-FRAME
5a98.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches an object's four-byte geometry, enlarges it by two columns and12 rows, clears/configures the zoom hit map, then expands a repeated border around the scene picture.

5b30.name: COMPOSE-OBJECT-LIST
5b30.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks the byte list range; item-class IDs use dropped-item composition and scene-class IDs use picture/mask composition.

5b61.name: COMPOSE-VIEW
5b61.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Gets the current room's view list, prepares its first object's zoom frame, then composes every listed object into it.

5b80.name: RESTORE-SCENE-BACKGROUND
5b80.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the saved background picture at $0A00 through DRAW-DECODED-PICTURE. The extra banked byte restore present in Klatwa is absent.

5b8d.name: PUSH-AND-DRAW-VIEW
5b8d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Composes the view, saves the base background when entering the first zoom, pushes its ID, draws its picture and configures its cursor.

5bb0.name: ENTER-VIEW
5bb0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves current cursor position, invokes $5B8D and centers the new view cursor.

5bc1.name: REDRAW-CURRENT-VIEW
5bc1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches top view ID through P, recomposes it and draws the scene picture.

5bd4.name: LEAVE-VIEW
5bd4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pops/discards the current view; redraws the preceding zoom or restores the base background, then reconfigures/restores its cursor.

5bfc.name: ENTER-INVENTORY-VIEW
5bfc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves any active zoom background/cursor, pushes view1 and composes its special room0/view1 object list before drawing and configuring the cursor.

5c3a.name: LEAVE-INVENTORY-VIEW
5c3a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pops inventory view, restores base background, then rebuilds the preceding nested views and restores saved cursor coordinates.

5c7c.name: LOAD-ITEM-ART-ENABLED
5c7c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When nonzero, $5C88 loads the following resource group into ITEM-RESOURCE-BASE after the main banked group succeeds.

5c88.name: LOAD-PART-RESOURCES
5c88.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loads up to120 sectors into logical bank offset0; if item-art loading is enabled, also loads60 sectors of the next group into item-art RAM. Retries on disk failure.

5ce2.name: NIC
5ce2.evidence: Candidate name; structural sequence match, not an independently verified semantic match. 5cec.name: KEYBOARD-SELECTION
5cec.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Input wait stores the one-based key-list match here. A nonzero value also ends the wait even if the trigger is not pressed.

5cf6.name: KEYBOARD-SHORTCUTS-ENABLED
5cf6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Multiplier applied to the raw key-list match in input wait; zero suppresses keyboard selection.

5d00.name: BASE-VIEW-KEYS-ENABLED
5d00.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Together with an empty view stack, gates whether input wait interprets the shortcut key list; high-level modal screens change this flag.

5d09.name: WAIT-TRIGGER-RELEASE
5d09.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeatedly samples active-low controller0 trigger with five-frame pauses until released.

5d20.name: SHORTCUT-KEYCODES
5d20.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Three bytes at body address $5D22 are raw CH keycodes21,05,28; input wait searches them directly. The saved DOCOL field is not executed.
5d20.calling_convention: Data body referenced by literal address; do not execute its saved DOCOL entry.

5d2e.name: WAIT-GAME-INPUT
5d2e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears CH, initializes cursor players, waits for trigger release, applies controller0 movements and shortcut keys until trigger/key selection, then returns the grid x/y bytes and disables players.

5dda.name: DEFAULT-GAME-COLORS
5dda.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initial color bytes copied into GAME-COLOR-TABLE by $5E1A, with the seventh byte used for COLPF3 shadow.

5deb.name: INSTALL-GAME-COLORS
5deb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Points the DLI at GAME-COLOR-TABLE, enables two display-list interrupt bits, installs the handler and writes COLPF3 shadow.

5e1a.name: RESET-GAME-COLORS
5e1a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies seven default color bytes to the live table and installs the game's color DLI.

5e2f.name: AUDIO-RESOURCE-ANCHOR
5e2f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $8CB9 is the anchor from which gameplay CMC module location is calculated; $5FBB subtracts $076C to select actual module address $854D.

5e3a.name: CMC-MODULE-ADDRESS
5e3a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell supplied as X/Y to CMC command $70 by $5E81; stores the module load address.

5e44.name: SAVED-DMA-CONTROL
5e44.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the previous Atari SDMCTL $022F value before display DMA is disabled.

5e4e.name: DISPLAY-OFF
5e4e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves SDMCTL $022F and writes zero to disable display DMA.

5e6a.name: RESTORE-DISPLAY
5e6a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores the saved value of SDMCTL $022F.

5e81.name: INITIALIZE-AUDIO
5e81.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native routine passes the audio data address and initialization selector to the embedded player entry $3003.

5ea0.name: CMC-SONG-NUMBER
5ea0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Low byte is supplied in X to CMC command0 by $5EAA; PLAY-MUSIC stores its requested song here.

5eaa.name: START-CMC-SONG
5eaa.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves Forth X, invokes dispatcher $3003 with A=0 and song number in X, restores X and returns NEXT.

5ec2.name: SELECT-AUDIO-SEQUENCE
5ec2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the requested audio sequence then invokes the embedded player via the adjacent native helper.

5ed6.name: STOP-AUDIO
5ed6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native call to embedded player $3003 with selector $40; called when the title is skipped.

5eea.name: MUSIC-PAUSED
5eea.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Console-key music handler toggles this byte when pausing/resuming CMC playback.

5ef5.name: UPDATE-CMC-MUSIC
5ef5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: VBI-callable native routine checks CONSOL: value3 sends stop command$40 and sets pause flag; value5 sends resume$60 and clears it. Always calls player frame routine$3006 before RTS.
5ef5.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5f26.name: CMC-EFFECT-PARAMETERS
5f26.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two bytes passed as X/Y to CMC command$21 by $5F30.

5f30.name: PLAY-CMC-EFFECT
5f30.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves Forth X, calls CMC dispatcher with A=$21 and parameter bytes X/Y from $5F26, then returns NEXT.

5f4a.name: CMC-EFFECT!
5f4a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the two bytes in CMC-EFFECT-PARAMETERS then invokes PLAY-CMC-EFFECT.

5f60.name: SOUND-EFFECT-TABLE
5f60.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array of paired CMC effect bytes. PLAY-SOUND-EFFECT at $5F9C indexes an effect, reads its two parameters and invokes CMC-EFFECT!.

5f9c.name: PLAY-SOUND-EFFECT
5f9c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When MUSIC-PAUSED is nonzero, indexes SOUND-EFFECT-TABLE, fetches its byte pair and calls CMC-EFFECT!; otherwise discards the effect number.

5fbb.name: SET-GAME-MUSIC-ADDRESS
5fbb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Subtracts $076C from AUDIO-RESOURCE-ANCHOR ($8CB9), storing $854D as the CMC module address for gameplay.

5fd1.name: INITIALIZE-GAME-DISPLAY
5fd1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Disables the display, installs game display resources and font at $BC00, initializes audio, then restores DMA.

6015.name: POWER-LIST-SEPARATOR
6015.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints a 26-byte decorative divider with (S"); $603C places the same divider above and below the eight power names.

603c.name: SHOW-POWER-LIST
603c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints SPIS MOCY (list of powers), then four rows containing the eight $5517 records in two columns. Each name occupies 13 bytes at record+5.

610e.name: ERROR-SOUND
610e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls sound dispatcher $5F9C with command19; used for wrong items, unavailable powers, forbidden actions and full inventory.

611d.name: FIND-SCENE-OBJECT
611d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Gets a mutable room/view record through $59DC and searches its payload through $3896. Returns 0 if absent, or its byte address followed by 1 if present.

6142.name: POWER-ERROR-MESSAGES
6142.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Length-record vector with unavailable-power and missing-required-item messages, indexed by $61F2. The middle entry is an incomplete retained placeholder.

61cf.name: REQUIRED-ITEM-PRESENT?
61cf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads a required item byte and searches room0/view1 inventory via $611D. A zero requirement succeeds even when no matching inventory byte is found.

61f2.name: SELECT-REQUIRED-POWER
61f2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Displays the eight powers, reads the selected slot, checks its first metadata byte against the supplied power ID and its next two bytes with $61CF; displays $6142 errors on failure.

6288.name: POWER-TEXT-POINTERS
6288.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two writable cells used by $6294/$74AD for source counted power name and destination display slot; the four-byte body is not a single scalar state.

6294.name: PREPARE-POWER-SLOT
6294.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Searches eight $5517 records for the same power ID or an empty slot, copies three metadata bytes, and stores source/destination text pointers in $6288. The original assumes a suitable slot exists.

62e7.name: ACTION-LABELS
62e7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Length-record vector used by $65ED; the 80 dispatch indices include one-byte aliases dereferenced once, including two targets outside the known label table.

6518.name: ACTION-RECORD-BUFFER
6518.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $8D20, destination for copied scene action collections through $653F.

6522.name: SELECTED-META-POINTER
6522.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Holds the selected scene object's metadata pointer, read through $6796.

652c.name: SELECTED-ACTION-LIST
652c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Points to the action collection selected by object/inventory/system-menu helpers; $6642 iterates this collection.

6535.name: SELECTED-OBJECT
6535.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Holds the hit/object ID chosen by $65C9 and used by menu and take/remove handlers.

653f.name: SELECT-SCENE-ACTIONS
653f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Looks up object+200 in current room metadata, saves metadata+2 in $6522, then copies the selected action collection to scratch $8D20 and points $652C there. Falls back to collection1 when absent.

658c.name: SELECT-INVENTORY-ACTIONS
658c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For a nonzero item ID, scans records1..99 in game resource1 for a record whose byte+4 equals that ID, setting $652C to the matching action list.

65c9.name: SELECT-OBJECT-ACTIONS
65c9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the object ID in $6535; IDs above200 use $658C inventory lookup and lower IDs use $653F room metadata lookup.

65ed.name: APPEND-ACTION-LABEL
65ed.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies an indexed $62E7 label to an 8-bit counted destination and returns its next address. A one-byte label is dereferenced once as an alias; chained/out-of-table aliases are not normalized.

6624.name: MENU-ACTION-INDICES
6624.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell-indexed array filled by $6642 alongside menu lines and read by $66F6 to map a selected row to the handler table.

6642.name: BUILD-ACTION-MENU
6642.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Builds counted lines at $481B from the selected object's up-to-ten action records; stores parallel dispatch indices in $6624 and adds no-action/leave-view entries as appropriate.

66ec.name: SELECTED-ACTION-RECORD
66ec.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pointer to the action record selected by $66F6; $6777 addresses its payload after the two-byte length.

66f6.name: CHOOSE-ACTION-MENU
66f6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets the cursor grid for the prepared menu, reads a row, stores its action record in $66EC, and returns the parallel $6624 dispatch index.

676a.name: CHOOSE-OBJECT-ACTION
676a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Builds the selected-object menu with $6642, then returns the user's action selection through $66F6.

6777.name: ACTION-BYTE-ADDR
6777.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds the supplied byte offset and2 to the pointer stored at $66EE; the first two bytes of each selected action record hold its length. Verified by original-6502 probes.

6789.name: ACTION-BYTE@
6789.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls $6777 then C@; reads a byte within the selected action payload. Verified by original-6502 probes.

6796.name: SELECTED-OBJECT-META
6796.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches the metadata pointer stored in $6522 by scene-object action selection.

67a3.name: OBJECT-META-0
67a3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches the first byte of metadata returned by $6796; its interpretation depends on the dispatched action.

67b0.name: OBJECT-META-1
67b0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches metadata byte1 through $6796; different handlers use it as a required item, room/view or state index.

67bf.name: OBJECT-META-2
67bf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches metadata byte2 through $6796; different handlers use it as a state index, replacement object or message.

67ce.name: ADD-SCENE-OBJECT
67ce.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses $611D to avoid duplicates in a room/view list; otherwise fills its first zero byte. Returns1 for present/inserted and0 when no free position exists.

6808.name: ADD-CURRENT-OBJECT
6808.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls $67CE with current room $550D and current view P, discarding the success flag.

681c.name: REMOVE-SCENE-OBJECT
681c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Finds the object in a room/view list through $611D and clears that byte if present.

6833.name: REMOVE-CURRENT-OBJECT
6833.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls $681C with current room $550D and current view P.

6844.name: MSG-INVENTORY-FULL
6844.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counted message NIE UNIESIESZ TYLE, displayed when $6863 cannot insert an inventory item.

6863.name: ADD-INVENTORY-ITEM
6863.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds an item to room0/view1, computes its occupied-slot X and Y=$4E in $55B4, and returns success. On full inventory displays NIE UNIESIESZ TYLE (you cannot carry this much).

68c3.name: REMOVE-INVENTORY-ITEM
68c3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Removes an item from room0/view1 through $681C.

68d2.name: ACTION-ARG1
68d2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches selected action payload byte1 through $6789.

68df.name: ACTION-ARG2
68df.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches selected action payload byte2 through $6789.

68ec.name: ACTION-ARG3
68ec.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches selected action payload byte3 through $6789.

68fa.name: ACTION-ARG4
68fa.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches selected action payload byte4 through $6789.

6908.name: ACTION-ARG5
6908.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches selected action payload byte5 through $6789.

6916.name: ACTION-ARG6
6916.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches selected action payload byte6 through $6789.

6924.name: ACTION-ARG7
6924.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches selected action payload byte7 through $6789.

6934.name: HIT-ID>POSITION
6934.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Searches the hit-map buffer $4DB2 for a hit ID, divides the resulting offset by grid width, and converts it to pixel/byte coordinates relative to the active view. Caller $7140 uses hit201 for an inventory item's dropped position.

697c.name: MSG-NO-ITEM-SELECTED
697c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counted message NIE POKAZALES RZECZY, displayed after an empty inventory choice.

699c.name: CHOOSE-INVENTORY-ITEM
699c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Shows inventory, reads a cursor selection, converts it through $5298, and restores the prior view. A zero selection displays NIE POKAZALES RZECZY (you did not indicate an item).

69c5.name: INITIAL-MENU-RECORDS
69c5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Although its code field is DOCOL, $69EC uses its PFA $69C7 as length-record data: placeholder action1 and new-game/load entries7/8. It is not executed as a colon word.

69da.name: ACTIVE-MENU-RECORDS
69da.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Although its code field is DOCOL, $69EC uses its PFA $69DC as length-record data with placeholder action1 and save entry9; no threaded execution is inferred.

69ec.name: SELECT-SYSTEM-MENU
69ec.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Discards its incoming object, selects menu data $69DC during play or $69C7 before play, sets selected object1, and clears command state $5CEC.

6a1c.name: MISSION-BIT-COUNT
6a1c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Result cell whose low byte is reset/incremented by native $6A26 and used by percentage display $6A9D.

6a26.name: COUNT-MISSION-BITS
6a26.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native loop counts all set bits in 25 bytes starting at $57E2 and stores the result byte at $6A1E.

6a4e.name: MARK-ROOM-PROGRESS
6a4e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses current room to address $57E2+room (the PFA of variable $57E0); adds the supplied bit mask only if none of its bits are already set. Thus repeated single-bit awards are idempotent.

6a73.name: MSG-MISSION-PERCENT
6a73.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writable counted message WYKONALES ... PROCENT MISJI; $6A9D patches its two percentage digits.

6a9d.name: SHOW-MISSION-PERCENT
6a9d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: While a game is active, computes $6A1E*100/61 after counting mission bits, writes two digits into $6A73 and displays the progress message.

6adf.name: SELECT-INPUT-ACTION
6adf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Interprets command state $5CEC: zero selects object actions, one selects the system menu/progress, larger values map to dispatch index state+8. Clears the state before returning.

6b31.name: CHOOSE-SCENE-OBJECT
6b31.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Enables scene hit-test mode, reads cursor input and $5298 hit ID, excludes ID5, masks to five bits outside a close-up, then disables hit-test mode.

6b64.name: ACTION-HANDLER-PFAS
6b64.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The first80 cells form the validated handler-PFA table used by $6C1F, which converts each chosen PFA to CFA and executes it. Six retained tail bytes are not validated handler entries.

6c14.name: SAVED-ROOM-COLORS
6c14.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Three bytes copied from each room palette by $6C52, restored to $42E2 by $6D05 after temporary darkness.

6c1f.name: EXECUTE-ACTION
6c1f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes $6B64 to obtain a handler PFA, falls back to entry0 for a zero pointer, converts PFA to CFA, and EXECUTEs.

6c41.name: DROP5
6c41.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Exactly 2DROP 2DROP DROP; no application meaning beyond discarding five cells is inferred.

6c52.name: ENTER-ROOM
6c52.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears text, hides graphics, loads/draws the requested room through $59F0, copies room colors into live and saved palettes, prints its optional description, restores graphics and marks progress except in room1.

6ca9.name: REDRAW-HOOK
6ca9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: An empty colon definition called at the start of $6D4E. No extra behavior is present in this disk version.

6cbd.name: GAME-MAIN-LOOP
6cbd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initializes the game display and enters the persistent input, update and action loops called after the title.

6d05.name: RESTORE-ROOM-COLORS
6d05.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies three saved bytes from $6C14 to current room-color storage $42E2.

6d18.name: SET-DARK-ROOM-COLORS
6d18.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Replaces $42E2's first three bytes with 0,0,2; paired with restoration $6D05 by close/open and extinguish/light handlers.

6d31.name: PUZZLE-STATE@
6d31.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches indexed cell $5806+2*index through $5802; game-specific handlers use these cells as flags and counters. Verified by original-6502 probes.

6d40.name: PUZZLE-STATE!
6d40.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores through indexed cell array $5802 at $5806+2*index. Verified by original-6502 probes.

6d4e.name: REFRESH-SCENE-HIT-MAP
6d4e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Invokes the redraw hook, resets the hit-map selector, then copies picture/hit-map data via $541A and draws the scene picture buffer via $5441 after object changes. This does not establish a cursor-restoration operation.

6d85.name: DRAW-BASE-AND-OVERLAY
6d85.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Converts the lower object ID with $5958 and draws its base through $5916; converts the upper ID and, when nonzero, overlays it through $5928.

6da0.name: DRAW-OBJECT-CHANGE
6da0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws base and optional overlay through $6D85, then refreshes hit-test and cursor state with $6D4E.

6daf.name: DRAW-TWO-OVERLAYS
6daf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves a third object ID, draws base/first overlay through $6D85, optionally draws the second overlay through $5928, then refreshes hit-test state.

6dc9.name: WAIT-KEY-OR-FIRE
6dc9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears CH $02FC to $FF and waits until a keycode appears or joystick trigger zero is pressed.

6df4.name: MSG-WHAT
6df4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counted prompt CO? (what?), shown before generic and restricted drop-item actions.

6e04.name: SHOW-GAME-MESSAGE
6e04.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Divides message ID by30 to choose a bank and record in game resource2, then displays the nested counted message with $45A1.

6e23.name: SHOW-ACTION-ERROR
6e23.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears text, plays the error sound, then displays the selected game message through $6E04.

6e34.name: SHOW-RESOURCE-MESSAGE
6e34.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects a resource collection, clears text and displays the counted message at its first record+4.

6e4c.name: ACT-NOTHING
6e4c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 00 correspond to NIC. Empty handler; the dispatcher also falls back to this entry for a null target.

6e55.name: ACT-LEAVE-VIEW
6e55.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 01 correspond to NIE PATRZ. Plays sound9 and calls $5BD4 to leave the current close-up.

6e65.name: ACT-UNUSED-NOOP
6e65.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 02 correspond to unresolved alias94. Empty handler. The label's one-byte alias points outside the retained 80-entry table, so no label meaning is guessed.

6e6e.name: RETAINED-QUEST-OBJECT-PAIRS
6e6e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Retained Klatwa-style five object/room byte pairs used by $6EE0, whose required rooms25..28 are absent from Wladcy initial room table: (31,25),(130,28),(107,28),(7,25),(107,23).

6e80.name: FLASH-BACKGROUND
6e80.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves COLOR4 $02C8, writes color $0E for three frames, then restores the previous value.

6ea0.name: COUNT-LEGACY-PLACED-ITEMS
6ea0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Retained Klatwa-style logic counts items202,203,204,205 in rooms25,26,27,28 respectively, always view1. The initial Wladcy table has only rooms0..24, so no active quest is established.

6ed1.name: LEGACY-FOUR-ITEM-FLAG
6ed1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns puzzle-state cell13, used as the latch by retained four-item routine $6EE0; an active Wladcy quest is not established.

6ee0.name: CHECK-LEGACY-FOUR-ITEM-QUEST
6ee0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Retained Klatwa-style code gates on rooms25..28, tests four placed items, inserts $6E6E pairs, marks progress, attempts to display resource49 as a message and sets cell13. Wladcy initial room table ends at room24 and its resource49 is picture data; this is not proven reachable as a working quest.

6f89.name: OBJECT-FRAME-PARTS
6f89.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Divides by100 and doubles the quotient: result is remainder followed by 2*quotient. Used to split decimal-encoded animation selectors; verified by original-6502 boundary probes.

6f9b.name: ANIMATION-STOP-FLAG
6f9b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cleared by $6FE5, set by $6FB8 after joystick fire, and tested to terminate the two-frame animation loop.

6fa5.name: ANIMATION-FIRST-SELECTOR
6fa5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two bytes storing the first selector's resource and doubled frame quotient, written by $6FE5 after $6F89.

6faf.name: ANIMATION-SECOND-SELECTOR
6faf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two bytes storing the second selector's resource and doubled frame quotient, written by $6FE5 after $6F89.

6fb8.name: WAIT-ANIMATION-OR-FIRE
6fb8.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits up to nine frames; a joystick press sets $6F9B, clears text and exits the loop early.

6fe5.name: ANIMATE-PAIR-UNTIL-FIRE
6fe5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Splits two selectors through $6F89 into $6FA5/$6FAF, alternates their selected images with nine-frame waits and sound7, and stops after joystick fire.

703e.name: FINAL-ITEM-BYTE?
703e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads a byte and tests 211 < item <216 (IDs212..215) with <=<. Used only by final room23 arrangement checks.

7054.name: FINAL-CENTRAL-LIST-READY?
7054.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counts qualifying items in three bytes of room23/view1 and succeeds only when exactly one is in the final-item range.

7082.name: FINAL-SIDE-LISTS-READY?
7082.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Tests the first object byte of room23/views2,3,4 and succeeds when all three satisfy $703E.

70af.name: CHECK-FINAL-ARRANGEMENT
70af.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When current room23 and both $7054/$7082 succeed, runs ending messages and animation, starts audio sequence1 and loops forever alternating resource images44/45.

7130.name: INVENTORY-ITEM-XY
7130.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Subtracts202 from an inventory item ID and indexes its mutable two-byte X/Y record through $55B4.

7140.name: ACT-DROP-ITEM
7140.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 03 correspond to ZOSTAW. Prompts for an inventory item, moves its XY to the selected scene position, removes it from inventory, adds it to the current view, redraws, and checks both delivery/final-arrangement puzzles.

7197.name: TAKE-SELECTED-ITEM
7197.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Attempts to add $6535 to inventory; success removes it from the scene, adds placeholder1, redraws and plays sound17. Item218 also sets puzzle cell9; returns success/failure.

71d7.name: ACT-TAKE-ITEM
71d7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 04 correspond to WEZ. Calls $7197 and discards its success flag.
