824b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 4A correspond to ZOSTAW. Asks for an inventory item and accepts only exact ID argument2; consumes it, reveals argument1 and redraws, or displays argument3 for a wrong choice.

8288.name: ACT-PATCH-WITH-ITEM
8288.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 4C correspond to ZALATAJ. Requires metadata byte0's item, stores argument2 into state argument3, consumes that item and applies the shared open result.

82b1.name: ACT-RELEASE-POWER-IN-VIEW
82b1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Dispatch $6B64 slots 4D,4F correspond to POTRZYJ; WLACZ. Only in room argument1 and view argument2, removes the selected object and learns its inline power record beginning after action byte4; other locations display argument3's error.

82f0.name: SAVED-DICTIONARY-STATE
82f0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two cells hold the dictionary end and latest header restored by RESTORE-DICTIONARY-LIMITS.

82fb.name: SAVE-DICTIONARY-LIMITS
82fb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves HERE and LATEST into the two cells of SAVED-DICTIONARY-STATE, paired with existing RESTORE-DICTIONARY-LIMITS.

8312.name: RESTORE-DICTIONARY-LIMITS
8312.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores DP and cold-start origin fields 28, 30 and 12 from SAVED-DICTIONARY-STATE.

8348.name: TITLE-DISPLAY-LIST-TEMPLATE
8348.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Seven ANTIC display-list bytes used by $83EB/$856F to insert/reset the scrolling title text rows.

8357.name: TITLE-LMS-ADDRESS
8357.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $A7E6; points at the title text display-list address field and is the base for row editing.

8362.name: TITLE-TEXT-SCREEN
8362.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $A0D5, installed as the title text screen by $83DA and used for page clearing/printing.

836d.name: TITLE-FOOTER-SCREEN
836d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $A28D; SETUP-TITLE-TEXT writes this address minus80 to SAVMSC before drawing footer text.

8378.name: TITLE-DISPLAY-ROW
8378.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loop row index used by $83EB to place the six-byte display-list scroll template.

8382.name: TITLE-SKIP-FLAG
8382.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initially zero; title input sets it on trigger press and title animation loops test it to exit.

838c.name: POLL-TITLE-FIRE
838c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears attract mode at $4D, checks joystick fire, sets the title skip flag, and stops audio.

83b7.name: WAIT-TITLE-FRAMES
83b7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits frame-by-frame while polling title fire and exits early when TITLE-SKIP-FLAG is set.

83da.name: SET-TITLE-SCREEN-POINTER
83da.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes title text-screen address $A0D5 into the display-list pointer at $A7E6.

83eb.name: INSERT-TITLE-SCROLL-ROW
83eb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies six template bytes from $8348 into title display list $A7E6+2+$8378.

8409.name: TITLE-DISPLAY-LIST-SCRATCH
8409.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Thirteen-byte temporary copy used by $8420 while shifting the title display list by two bytes; residual ALLOT text has no inferred runtime meaning.

8420.name: PREPARE-TITLE-DISPLAY
8420.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves13 display-list bytes in $8409, reinserts them two bytes later, installs the title screen pointer and clears700 text-screen bytes.

844f.name: DRAW-TITLE-FRAME
844f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the supplied resource collection through $485C, then draws its image0 through $4D31.

8460.name: LOAD-TITLE-ASSETS
8460.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Performs title disk loading with an error branch, installs picture resources, and selects the title font.

84f6.name: VSCROL
84f6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $D405, the ANTIC vertical-scroll hardware register written by the title reveal/hide routines.

8500.name: PRINT-CENTERED-TITLE-TEXT
8500.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Centers a counted text object around column 20, sets cursor position, and prints it with STYPE.

8526.name: TITLE-VSCROLL-UP
8526.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes0,2,4,6 to ANTIC VSCROL $D405 with one title-aware frame wait after each value.

8548.name: TITLE-VSCROLL-DOWN
8548.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes6,4,2,0 to ANTIC VSCROL $D405 with one title-aware frame wait after each value.

856f.name: RESET-TITLE-SCROLL
856f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores five template bytes at display-list $A7E6+2 and clears ANTIC VSCROL.

858c.name: TITLE-ROW-OFFSET
858c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Row offset added while laying out title text lines; initialized and adjusted by title page animation.

8596.name: TITLE-PAGE-LINE-COUNT
8596.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the current title page text count and controls the forward and reverse line-animation loops.

85a0.name: PRINT-TITLE-PAGE
85a0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loops over counted text lines in the active resource, placing each at line index+TITLE-ROW-OFFSET through PRINT-CENTERED-TITLE-TEXT.

85ca.name: SHOW-TITLE-TEXT-RECORD
85ca.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loads an indexed text record from resource collection9 through $4849, then prints it with $85A0.

85e1.name: ANIMATE-TITLE-PAIR
85e1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeats resource6/image0 for7 frames and resource5/image0 for12 frames, aborting when TITLE-SKIP-FLAG is set.

8612.name: SETUP-TITLE-TEXT
8612.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets SAVMSC relative to title-text storage, resets the title row offset, and prints cursor controls.

863b.name: SHOW-INITIAL-TITLE-TEXT
863b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Displays text records0 and8 with their prescribed row offsets, resets scrolling and calls SETUP-TITLE-TEXT.

865e.name: SCROLL-TITLE-PAGE
865e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loads an indexed title page, records its line count, reveals rows using display-list/VSCROL changes, runs the title animation, and scrolls rows away again.

86ee.name: RUN-TITLE-PAGES
86ee.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cycles seven animated title text pages until TITLE-SKIP-FLAG is set.

871d.name: BOOT-TITLE-AND-GAME
871d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Boot entry loads title resources, runs title pages, restores dictionary limits and enters GAME-MAIN-LOOP.
